# Trigger conditions

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## attacks

The subject is declared as an attacker.

Rules: CR 508.3a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, ...} |

```json
{
  "attacks": {
    "subject": "self"
  }
}
```

## cast

A player casts a spell. `controller`: you (default) | opponent | any; `spell`: optional filter on the spell's card types (e.g. "creature", "noncreature").

Rules: CR 603.2, CR 601.2i

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `controller` | you | opponent | any |
| `spell` | creature | noncreature | instant_or_sorcery |

```json
{
  "cast": {
    "controller": "you",
    "spell": "noncreature"
  }
}
```

## dies

The subject is put into a graveyard from the battlefield. Looks back in time (CR 603.10a).

Rules: CR 603.6c, CR 603.10a, CR 700.4

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, ...} |

```json
{
  "dies": {
    "subject": "self"
  }
}
```

## enters

The subject enters the battlefield.

Rules: CR 603.6a, CR 603.2

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subject` | "self" (default) or {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": true} |

```json
{
  "enters": {
    "subject": {
      "each": "land",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## step_begins

A step begins. `whose`: "your" (default), "each" or "opponent".

Rules: CR 603.6b, CR 503.1a, CR 513.1a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `step` | upkeep | draw | precombat_main | end | ... |
| `whose` | your | each | opponent |

```json
{
  "step_begins": {
    "step": "upkeep",
    "whose": "your"
  }
}
```
